hints.title: Reading dead wheel encoders
hints.content: Dead wheels are wired to encoder ports and read like regular motors: `DcMotor forwardEncoder = hardwareMap.get(DcMotor.class, "forwardEncoder");` then `int ticks = forwardEncoder.getCurrentPosition();`.

hints.title: Computing distance from ticks
hints.content: Use: `double dist = (ticks / TICKS_PER_REV) * (Math.PI * WHEEL_DIAMETER);`. With TICKS_PER_REV=2000 and WHEEL_DIAMETER=0.048: 2000 ticks = 1 revolution = π × 0.048 ≈ 0.1508 m.

hints.title: Expected values
hints.content: Forward: 2000 / 2000 × (π × 0.048) ≈ 0.1508 m. Strafe: 500 / 2000 × (π × 0.048) ≈ 0.0377 m. The test checks within 0.001 m tolerance.
